name: 94132 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94132 (San Francisco) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94132 (San Francisco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
